payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iteratively fills the table using the recurrence a[i][j] = a[i-1][j] + a[i][j-1], then prints the maximum of the last row.
payload.rationale: The solution directly constructs the table with nested loops, which is simple DP, not a search. Among the forced complete_search subtypes, backtracking is chosen as the least unfitting, though no backtracking occurs.
